idea-plugin.name: LogSmith
idea-plugin.description: Shows which log format a .log file uses and how many lines matched — in a status line attached to the standard editor, with zero configuration. Detects 13 formats, colours records (timestamp, thread, logger, level ramp) without ever making rendering worse, and lets you switch colouring off per file. Capabilities land day by day per the charter (docs/charter.md).

action.text: Disable LogSmith highlighting for this file
action.description: Turn LogSmith colouring on or off for this file without restarting
